name: ReadComicOnline

client.user_agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/130.0.0.0 Safari/537.36

_selectors_note: The mandatory adapter implements complete parsing and skips the first two chapter-table rows. page_image is null because pages are decoded from script data, not image elements.

upstream.attribution: Keiyoushi contributors; static Lua adaptation for TachiKindle. Decoder configuration is never downloaded at runtime.

limitations: CAPTCHA and site protection are not solved; browser cookie sharing is not implemented.
Advanced genre/status/year/publisher/author filters, URL search, and the reader preference UI are not ported.
Static decoder supports the inspected upstream string transformations, not arbitrary or future JavaScript.
Reader image retrieval was deliberately not tested; only synthetic URL fixtures are used.
